decision.explanation: Multiple distinct values for the population of Young America Township appear across the provided sources, each tied to specific census years or estimates. These include 838 (2000 census in Minnesota), 1,200 (also 2000 census, possibly a conflicting value), 726 (2010 census in Edgar County, Illinois), and 582 (2023 estimate). Since the question does not specify a location or year, and the sources do not clarify whether these refer to the same or different Young America Townships, all valid referents and complementary answers are preserved.
